notes.title: Snapshot Spirit Live! is fully playable on the Steam Deck
notes.content: [p]I am proud to announce that my upcoming game, Snapshot Spirit Live!, is fully playable on the Steam Deck. I had always imagined this game as being ideal for the Deck, and I made sure to test it extensively on the Deck.[/p][p]It is completely playable using XInput with no mouse controls, and so the Deck's button inputs will feel perfectly natural from the title menu to the end credits.[/p][p]It also looks beautiful on the Steam Deck display. The original game window canvas is only 480 x 270 pixels, which allows it to scale up perfectly to a variety of common screen resolutions. And the Steam Deck handles it wonderfully. [/p][p]Enjoy Snapshot Spirit Live! on your Deck when it releases later this summer![/p]
